receipts.detail: G7 multi-resolution/adaptive materialization receives a concrete three-layer memory substrate: exact anchors, temporal semantic graph, transient activation. Physical monolith remains rejected.
Primary downstream: M.MEMORY_FABRIC integration plus S.ACTIVE_ASSEMBLY/validation candidates; exact CognitiveFrame and authority boundaries retained.
Graph activation may feed memory candidates but is not workspace ignition; preserve EVENT_WS transport/projection/uptake/effect receipts.
Active assemblies become intervention targets for recurrence, lesion/rescue and OOD tests; no consciousness claim.
Add versioned assertion envelope and exact-anchor witness semantics while keeping semantic hash/wire hash and external authority separation.
Three-topology separation directly constrains database migration; reified/n-ary relation identity and explicit conflict sets are retained.
Generation 1 qualified temporal activation is promising in a small proxy but not promoted.

shared_ancestry_rule: Receipts do not create independent evidence; they are downstream architecture/research feedback from one ClayGraph run.
